description: C4 (decision C4-8): Hollowmere's development - its first tier is B3's aftermath (the Rootwarden at rest: an auto project), its second a heartwood hall the giant carries the dead grove's trunks for.

heartwood.name: heartwood trunk
heartwood.from: the Rootwarden's grove north-west of Hollowmere, where his dead trees lie

tiers.name: The Lake-village
tiers.text: The woodfolk's stilt-village on the mere, under the blight.

tiers.name: The Warden at Rest
tiers.text: The Rootwarden sleeps for good; his heartwood lies in the village and Wren's woodworks work his bark.

unlocks.text: Wren's woodworks work the Rootwarden's wood (the Warden set).

projects.name: The warden at rest
projects.text: The woodfolk bring his heartwood home once you have gone.

tiers.name: The Heartwood Hall
tiers.text: A hall of carved heartwood posts under a thatch roof stands on the green, the woodfolk's moot-house.

unlocks.text: The woodfolk trade amber sap for wolf hides.
The woodfolk meet in their new hall.

projects.name: Raise the heartwood hall
projects.text: Sedge wants a moot-house of the grove's own dead, carved, where the woodfolk can meet under a roof. Two of the dead trunks, and a strip of the warden's bark for its door.
projects.raised_text: The posts stand. The woodfolk are already carving them.

needs.text: Carry two heartwood trunks from the grove
A strip of the Rootwarden's bark for its door
